title: Tic-tac at 31 times the speed of sound with no sonic signature

tellings.quote: so when an object can travel at greater than five times the speed of sound like the tic-tac which is estimated to reach at least 31 times the speed of sound and it doesn't disturb the air around you

plain: The Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, is estimated to have reached at least 31 times the speed of sound without disturbing the air around it, according to a young researcher named Deep Prasad. He says this on the show without naming a source, though he credits the thinker Eric Weinstein in the conversation, and he makes the point that anything past five times the speed of sound should normally shake the air, so a craft that does not would be beyond known physics.
